components.name: Sun above Solar Panel
components.description: A small sun with short radial rays sits above a sloping solar panel divided into four cells. Exclude the charging pillar and bolt.

components.name: Tall Charging Pillar
components.description: An upright pillar has rounded upper corners and a flat base. Exclude the lightning bolt, solar panel and sun.

components.name: Charging Lightning Mark
components.description: A narrow angular lightning mark bends through two opposing diagonal strokes. Exclude the pillar, sun and solar panel.
